records.subject: You're in -- let's get Silver Analytics set up
records.body:
Hi Wei,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Customer explicitly said they're "still deciding if this is the right tool" and asked for another week (email:d92d89c1), signalling paused evaluation. First project reached day 1 but no invite sent and no key milestone in 6 days; 8 days left. Engaged enough to reply, so not negligible.

draft.subject: Re: A few days into Wrenfield — how's it going?
draft.body:
Hi Wei,

Thanks for being straight with me — taking another week to decide makes sense, and I won't crowd you.

One thing that often helps an evaluation: seeing how the work actually flows for your team. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the shape of that first project usually tells you a lot about fit.

If it's useful, I'm happy to spend 20 minutes this week looking at your current project with you and answering anything on your list. If you'd rather circle back next week, just say the word.

Best,
Chidi
